description: Read one PropertyList guide. Answer from its text and link its url. If last_reviewed is set, say the page was checked on that date; if it is null, say the page shows no review date. If truncated is true, call again with offset set to next_offset. It is general information, not legal or tax advice.

max_chars.description: Most characters of text to return (default 12000).

offset.description: Where to continue a long page: the next_offset of the previous call.

url.description: The guide on info.propertylist.es: a full URL from search_guides, or its path (/docs/...).

name: get_guide

last_reviewed.description: The page's own review date, as the page states it; null when it shows none.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset to read on, when truncated.

url.description: Canonical URL of the page; link it.

title: Read a guide
